steps.title: Spoken argument structure: signpost ideas and repair without losing your line
steps.body: Task 3 speaking gives no preparation time. Your goal is not a perfect essay read aloud; it is a clear response that develops relevant ideas and stays responsive. Use a short thesis, two signposted reasons, a relevant example, a fair limitation and a conclusion. Use connectors to show the relationship, not to decorate every sentence. If you lose a word, paraphrase (ce que je veux dire, c'est…) and continue. A self-correction is useful when it clarifies meaning; repeatedly restarting can make the line harder to follow.

steps.title: Spoken argument structure: signpost ideas and repair without losing your line
rows: Position
à mon avis + claim
À mon avis, les bibliothèques doivent rester accessibles en personne.
In my view, libraries should remain accessible in person.
Reason
d'abord / ensuite
D'abord, elles offrent un espace de travail; ensuite, elles donnent accès à des ressources.
First, they provide a place to work; then, they offer access to resources.
Example
prenons l'exemple de…
Prenons l'exemple d'une personne qui n'a pas d'espace calme chez elle.
Take the example of someone who does not have a quiet space at home.
Qualification
cela dit / à condition que
Cela dit, les horaires doivent répondre aux besoins du quartier.
That said, the hours must meet the neighbourhood's needs.
Repair
ce que je veux dire, c'est…
Ce que je veux dire, c'est que l'accès doit être simple.
What I mean is that access should be simple.

steps.prompt: Which order creates a clear short argument?
options: Conclusion before the prompt is understood
steps.explain: This order keeps the answer relevant and developed.

steps.prompt: What does ce que je veux dire, c'est… do?
steps.explain: It helps clarify or repair what the speaker means.

steps.prompt: How should a personal example be framed?
options: As one illustration, not proof about everyone
As a replacement for a position
steps.explain: One example illustrates a point but does not establish a universal claim.
